name: 77566 · Lake Jackson, TX
findings: ZIP 77566 (Lake Jackson) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77566 (Lake Jackson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77566 (Lake Jackson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.
